sources.title: Chatbot Arena - OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: This leaderboard is based on the following benchmarks. Arena + — an agent-driven battle platform for large language models (LLMs). We use LLM-as-a-judge to compute Elo ratings. AAII — Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index aggregating 10 challenging evaluations. ARC-AGI — Artificial General Intelligence benchmark v2 to measure fluid intelligence.
